title: Gen-RecSys: A 2024 Review of Generative Recommender Systems
summary: This community centers on the 2024 arXiv paper 'A Review of Modern Recommender Systems Using Generative Models (Gen-RecSys)'. The cluster consists of the paper itself and its ten co-authors, who are linked solely through their authorship contributions. The paper serves as a comprehensive survey of how generative models are applied to modern recommender systems.
key_findings: The central entity is a 2024 review paper titled 'A Review of Modern Recommender Systems Using Generative Models (Gen-RecSys)' published on arXiv (ID: 2404.00579).
The paper is authored by a collaborative team of ten researchers, including Yashar Deldjoo, Zhankui He, and Julian McAuley.
Additional authors in this cluster include Anton Korikov, Scott Sanner, Arnau Ramisa, René Vidal, Maheswaran Sathiamoorthy, Atoosa Kasirzadeh, and Silvia Milano.
All internal relationships within this community are defined by the 'AUTHORED_BY' link connecting the paper to its respective authors.
The paper is categorized under the field of Information Retrieval (cs.IR) as indicated by its arXiv classification.
The community represents a specific scholarly contribution focused on the intersection of generative AI and recommendation algorithms.
